baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 2 names life outside ordinary human familiarity, while the passive verb at word 3 depicts gathering that includes driving toward a destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinarily dispersed and mutually unassociated creatures are dislodged from their separate ranges and compelled into one directed convergence. The passive construction suppresses the driver while retaining coercion and destination.

activation_trace.role: Wildness literally lies outside human familiarity and supplies the normally non-associating population whose separation is overturned.
Gathering literally includes driving a group toward a destination and supplies the coercive vector and common endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A static picture of beasts collected together.
changed_reading.after: A directed rupture of animal dispersal: life defined by avoidance of familiar company is driven from separate ranges to one destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The semantic range of word 2 includes deserted, peopleless space and an away-facing outer side; word 3 relocates a group to a muster point.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can organize space rather than merely count animals. Humanless interiors and away-facing margins cease to function as protected outsides when what belongs to them is translated into a common center.

activation_trace.role: Desolate absence of people literally supplies the vacant habitat from which the gathered life is imagined to come.
The away-facing outer side literally supplies a peripheral orientation that the gathering reverses toward a center.
Driven collection to a destination supplies the spatial translation from multiple margins into one muster.

changed_reading.before: Animals happen to occupy the same place.
changed_reading.after: The category of outside is being abolished: inhabitants of vacant and away-facing space are transferred into a shared center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 supplies the broad wild population, and a branch under the root of word 3 names proliferating small earth creatures.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots can widen the scene from conspicuous beasts to a cross-scale convocation of terrestrial life. The gathering totalizes what human vision usually separates into impressive animals and negligible creeping creatures.

activation_trace.role: Wild creatures outside domesticated familiarity supply the broad ecological class.
The literal branch of numerous small earth creatures supplies the usually overlooked lower scale of the convocation.

changed_reading.before: Only large, dramatic beasts are rounded up.
changed_reading.after: Wild terrestrial life is assembled across scale, including the small proliferating creatures normally beneath notice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: One branch of word 2 evokes an empty belly, while one branch of word 3 evokes a hard year that sweeps populations and consumes wealth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gathering can be pressure-driven rather than merely commanded: depletion empties bodies and landscapes, then concentrates living beings that can no longer remain dispersed.

activation_trace.role: Empty-bellied hunger literally supplies bodily depletion as the pressure acting on the wild population.
A severe year literally drives people together and strips wealth, supplying scarcity as a concentrating force.

changed_reading.before: The gathering has no material cause visible in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: The muster can be heard as a scarcity sweep in which emptied bodies and depleted ranges force wild life into concentration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence removes fixed masses, leaves highly valued domestic life unattended, and destabilizes the largest water compartments. Against that sequence, the wild muster becomes a reversal of management and habitat: what humans stabilized is released, while what escaped human association is centrally driven.

activation_trace.role: Life outside human familiarity supplies the unmanaged side of the reversal.
Driven collection to a destination supplies the newly imposed organization of that unmanaged life.
A hard elevated mass literally supplies the paradigm of fixed landscape structure.
Removal and eviction literally make the fixed landscape mobile, supplying habitat displacement.
Ten-month camel pregnancy literally supplies concentrated domestic value and managed futurity.
Vacancy and abandonment literally suspend care for that managed value, reversing the focus ayah's centralization of the wild.
Vast abundant water literally supplies a major habitat boundary and reservoir.
Filling with water literally supplies one live transformation of the reservoir, overwhelming ordinary limits.
Water receding into emptiness literally supplies the opposite live transformation, loss of habitat rather than inundation.

structural_cues: The focus clause is one passive member of the repeated conditional sequence, so its suppressed agency is structurally shared with other imposed transformations.
Its placement between abandoned domestic wealth and transformed seas makes the managed/wild and containment/displacement reversals locally salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed elevation made mobile, valued pregnancy abandoned, and seas either filled or emptied; I infer that their common arrow is failure of ecological and managerial partitions, which drives wild convergence. A live alternative is that these are parallel signs with no causal relation to the animals.

changed_reading.before: One isolated prodigy in which beasts are assembled.
changed_reading.after: A hinge in a systemic reversal: managed value is released, stable habitats fail, and unmanaged life is subjected to a common destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abandonment, unappeased thirst, and the possible loss of water turn the focus root branches of empty belly and devastating year into a coherent migration mechanism. Wild populations converge because ordinary provisioning and ranges no longer sustain them.

activation_trace.role: Empty-bellied hunger supplies the bodily need that makes dispersal untenable.
The wealth-consuming hard year supplies a literal precedent for scarcity driving populations into concentration.
Abandonment and vacancy literally remove ordinary care and provisioning.
Severe thirst without satiation literally supplies the unmet resource pressure.
The emptying or recession of water literally supplies landscape-level depletion.

structural_cues: The focus follows the abandonment clause and precedes the sea clause, placing animal movement between failed care and altered water.
All three verbs are passive, leaving material pressure and external command as coexisting causal possibilities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hunger, a scarcity sweep, abandonment, thirst, and receding water; I supply the causal arrow from resource failure to animal migration and concentration. The live alternative is direct eschatological mustering without ecological mediation.

changed_reading.before: The beasts are collected by an unspecified force for an unspecified reason.
changed_reading.after: One live mechanism is emergency migration: deprivation and water loss collapse dispersed ranges into a single pressured concentration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following pairing of living selves supplies an operation more structured than crowding. The wild gathering can therefore be a reclassification in which creatures are brought together by kind, counterpart, form, or work.

activation_trace.role: Wild multiplicity outside familiar association supplies what must be newly related.
Directed gathering supplies the first-stage collection on which sorting can operate.
The life-bearing self literally supplies animate individuals rather than an undifferentiated mass.
Making one thing a counterpart of another literally supplies the pairing operation.
Peers grouped by shared form or action literally supplies a classificatory rule for the muster.

structural_cues: The next repeated passive clause changes from collective creatures to plural selves being paired.
The shared feminine plural passive pattern lets collection and pairing read as successive operations without requiring them to be identical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent collection and pairing, including a branch for grouping peers by form or work; I infer that pairing retroactively specifies a possible internal order of the animal muster. The alternative is a clean subject change in which 81:7 says nothing about the organization of 81:5.

changed_reading.before: All beasts are pressed into one undifferentiated crowd.
changed_reading.after: The gathering may be a sorted convocation, preserving distinctions by kind, counterpart, form, or conduct inside the common destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning, guilt, killing, and opened records supply a forensic destination for the focus verb's driven gathering. The animals can be convened not merely as spectacle but as affected beings, witnesses, claimants, or cases within an accounting.

activation_trace.role: Creatures normally outside human association supply nonhuman parties unexpectedly admitted to a common forum.
Driving a group to a destination literally supplies convocation before an implied forum.
Mutual questioning literally supplies the interrogative procedure of the forum.
Guilt or offense literally supplies the issue under examination.
Taking life literally supplies the harmed life around which accountability is organized.
The written sheet literally supplies a record for adjudicative disclosure.
Opening and spreading literally makes the record inspectable and supplies the disclosure stage.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ء د at 81:8, word 2, supplies only the structural position of a harmed and silenced victim; no branch identity is inferred for it.
The question in 81:9 targets the cause of killing, and the records clause follows immediately, producing a compact inquiry-and-evidence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a driven destination followed by a victim-position, questioning, guilt, killing, and opened records; I infer a tribunal-like purpose for one possible animal muster. A live alternative is that the sequence changes subjects and the animals have no forensic role.

changed_reading.before: The animals are gathered as one more object in a spectacle of upheaval.
changed_reading.after: They may be convened as nonhuman parties inside an accounting, making the muster juridical and ethical rather than merely visual.

context_deltas.mechanism: A long context chain opens, strips, brings near, makes present, sees at the horizon, clarifies, and negates withholding of the hidden. It activates the focus as forced visibility: creatures characterized by peopleless habitat and an away-facing side are brought from remote concealment into inspectable presence.

activation_trace.role: Peopleless desolation literally supplies a zone outside ordinary witness.
The away-facing side literally supplies orientation away from the observer.
Dislodging toward a destination supplies the transfer from remote margins into presence.
Opening, spreading, and branching literally supplies the first movement from enclosure to exposure.
Removing a cover and revealing what was hidden literally supplies radical unveiling.
Concealment and being screened literally supplies the hidden state that is reversed.
Movement into nearness literally supplies collapse of remoteness.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower literally supplies the epistemic result of exposure.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness literally supplies arrival before an observer.
Distant regions and horizons literally extend the model to the farthest visible margin.
Manifest appearance and uncovering literally supplies visibility at that margin.
Being screened from eyes literally supplies the final hidden domain subject to disclosure.
Holding something back literally supplies the operation negated by the clause, reinforcing non-withholding.

structural_cues: The sequence repeatedly converts covered or distant objects into opened, near, known, present, and visible ones.
The negation at 81:24 reverses the cited withholding branch, so the structural contribution is disclosure rather than stinginess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated open-strip-near-know-present-see-clear sequence and a hidden thing not withheld; I infer one cross-domain operation of abolishing concealment and apply it to the focus roots' remote, away-facing life. The alternative is a sequence of independent revelations without a shared spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Wild animals are moved together but may remain merely a distant mass.
changed_reading.after: The muster abolishes remoteness itself: life from peopleless, away-facing margins is forcibly made near, visible, and inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath sequence contains animal-specific branch images of gazelle refuge and a prowling wolf, joined to running, entering shelter, and dawn opening. These cues turn the focus from a finished heap into the terminal interruption of a living run-hide-hunt cycle: refuges cease to distribute predator and prey, and all are exposed to one convergence.

activation_trace.role: Wild land life literally supplies the predator-prey ecology whose ordinary motions are interrupted.
Dislodging and driving to one destination supplies the end of distributed refuge.
A gazelle refuge literally supplies a concrete wild hiding place.
Running and flowing literally supplies movement between exposed and sheltered positions.
Entering a screen or lair literally supplies retreat into protection.
A wolf's nocturnal roaming and search literally supplies predatory pressure around the refuge.
Dawn opening like a breath literally supplies the moment when hidden movement becomes exposed again.

structural_cues: The verbs of retreat, running, sheltering, nocturnal seeking, and dawn opening form a temporal cycle.
Animal branch images occur inside a celestial oath, allowing ecological and astral readings to coexist rather than forcing a choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gazelle shelter, running, entry into cover, a prowling wolf, and dawn opening; I infer that this motion ecology retroactively specifies what the focus gathering terminates. The live alternative is that the oath's movement applies only to celestial bodies and offers the focus no animal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse shows animals only after they have become a crowd.
changed_reading.after: It can mark the breakdown of the whole wild refuge cycle: running, hiding, hunting, and re-emergence are replaced by compulsory exposure at one site.

context_deltas.mechanism: Effective speech, dispatch, gathered strength, obedience, trust, straight alignment, will, and sovereignty supply an authority chain for the focus passive. Wildness remains wildness, but its centrifugal motion is subordinated to an effective command and aligned within a larger order.

activation_trace.role: Life outside familiarity supplies the strongest test case for imposed rather than habitual compliance.
Driving a group toward a destination supplies the commanded motion whose agent the passive leaves unstated.
A speaker whose word takes effect literally supplies operative command rather than mere description.
Sending and setting in motion literally supplies transmission of the command.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope literally supplies capacity to enforce convergence.
Compliance and obedience literally supplies the response side of the authority chain.
Settled trust literally characterizes the command channel as reliable rather than chaotic.
Straightness, balance, and alignment literally supplies the ordered geometry toward which motion is directed.
Will attached to an object literally supplies the ultimate volitional frame around subordinate motion.
Sovereignty and lordship literally supplies the highest authority under which the passive gathering occurs.

structural_cues: The focus passive withholds an agent; the later chain explicitly foregrounds effective speech, delegated transmission, power, obedience, and encompassing will.
The voluntary straightening addressed to humans coexists with the involuntary convergence of untamed creatures, producing an agency contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete authority chain and later nests straightening within will and sovereignty; I infer this as a candidate answer to the focus passive's suppressed agency and direction. The alternative is that messenger authority concerns revelation alone and does not explain the physical gathering.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous force herds animals during general chaos.
changed_reading.after: The convergence may enact ordered command: even life defined by non-domestication is aligned without ceasing to be wild.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distance, expulsion, and the question of where one is going reactivate the focus's away-facing wildness. The muster becomes spatial closure: centrifugal vectors still exist as images, but no path succeeds in preserving an outside to the gathering.

activation_trace.role: Separation from familiar company literally supplies social and spatial outsideness.
The away-facing side literally supplies a body oriented centrifugally from the center.
Directed driving literally reverses those outward orientations into one destination.
Distance and severance literally supplies a radical image of being outside.
Expulsion and banishment literally supplies an outward vector that nevertheless remains inside the discourse's reach.
Going and passing away literally supplies attempted departure.
A path or chosen way literally supplies the possible route whose destination the question destabilizes.

structural_cues: The direct question at 81:26 challenges the availability and direction of any departure.
The focus converts an away-oriented population into a destination-oriented passive group, already reversing the later vocabulary of distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wild outsideness, severance, expulsion, going, and a challenge to destination; I infer that the gathering closes the spatial system so no successful outside remains. The alternative is that 81:26 addresses human interpretation and does not retroactively constrain animal space.

changed_reading.before: The beasts move from many places to one place while an untouched outside remains conceivable.
changed_reading.after: The event closes every margin: what faces away, is expelled, or tries to depart is still gathered within one inescapable field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for the 81:8 source root, whose surface reading belongs to questioning. It remains worth carrying because gentle hidden extraction attaches directly to the focus's desolate margins and dislodging-to-muster mechanism. Downstream prose should label it a split-root, branch-led activation and never substitute extraction for the contextual verb's ordinary reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins peopleless or away-facing wild space to a verb of dislodging and driving toward a destination.

activation_trace.role: Desolate absence of people literally supplies hidden, unfrequented source habitats.
Dislodging and driving to a destination literally supplies the overt second stage of extraction.
The non-dominant branch of drawing something out gently and secretly literally supplies a hidden first stage before open mustering.
Slipping out and exiting literally supplies motion from concealment into the common field.

changed_reading.before: The animals appear only at the point of public collection.
changed_reading.after: A contained possibility adds an unseen preliminary operation: wild life is drawn out from hidden ranges before it is openly driven to the muster.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a compact or swollen bodily branch of ح ش ر and the piling of wrestlers are form-distant from the focus passive. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and receives a material analogue from wrapping and later breath. Downstream prose should present it only as a compression image, not as the lexical sense of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's root includes a compact, tightly packed bodily build, allowing the gathered plurality to be imaged materially as compression.

activation_trace.role: Dispersed wild plurality supplies the many bodies subjected to compression.
A dense, tightly packed or swollen build literally supplies the image of the multitude becoming one compact body.
Wrestlers piled over one another literally supplies a cross-domain analogue for bodies compacted into a mass.
Breath issuing from an interior literally supplies a possible release image after compression.

changed_reading.before: A plurality stands together while each body remains conceptually separate.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, gathering compacts dispersed wild bodies into a single swollen collective body whose later counterpart is release or breath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the regional post-harvest-residue branch under ح ش ر rather than the ordinary gathering branch. It remains anchored through the focus's hungry wild creatures and gains a context counterpart in dry pasture revived by rain. Downstream prose should call it an ecological branch scenario, not translate the focus verb as pasture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines wild creatures, an empty-belly branch, and a root branch for post-harvest residue where animals graze.

activation_trace.role: Empty-bellied hunger literally supplies the animals' motive to seek remnant forage.
Post-harvest field residue with grazing growth literally supplies a concrete convergence site for hungry animals.
Dry pasture revived by rain literally supplies a renewal counterpart to the residual grazing ground.

changed_reading.before: The destination of the gathering is wholly abstract.
changed_reading.after: A contained ecological scenario imagines hungry wild life converging on the last residual or newly revived forage after systemic stripping.

strongest_changes: The focus shifts from a static animal crowd to forced convergence produced by collapse of habitat and management boundaries.
The gathering can remain multiple in purpose: sorted pairing, forensic convocation, and forced exposure of remote life all have distinct packet-backed mechanisms.
Later refuge, authority, distance, and will cues turn the passive event into both the interruption of wild motion and the closure of every viable outside.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots already form a high-tension mechanism: life defined by non-familiarity, peopleless space, and away-facing orientation is paired with purposive driving to a destination. Context did not resolve that tension to one reading; it activated ecological collapse, domestic/wild reversal, classificatory order, accountability, disclosure, interrupted refuge, authoritative alignment, and spatial closure as coexisting models.
remaining_uncertainties: Environmental transformations may cause animal convergence, provide analogies for it, or simply stand beside it as independent signs.
The pairing and accountability sequence may specify the internal order and purpose of the muster, but the subject changes also permit no retroactive specification.
The split-root extraction, compressed-body, and remnant-pasture readings depend on form-distant branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
